name: Alessia Mancini
bio:
Alessia's passion for motorsport ignited during her childhood visits to Monza with her father, a former mechanic. Initially drawn to the roar of the engines, she soon became fascinated by the intricate logistical dance required to keep a racing team on track. After completing her degree in Supply Chain Management, she interned with a smaller Italian racing outfit, honing her skills in inventory management and transportation. 

Alessia believes that meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving are the cornerstones of effective logistics. At United Autosports, she is responsible for coordinating the movement of equipment and personnel, ensuring that everything arrives at the right place, at the right time, and in perfect condition. Her demanding nature pushes her team to perform at their best, while her unwavering loyalty ensures that they always have her support. She's known for her ability to find creative solutions to unexpected logistical challenges, keeping the team ahead of the curve.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied in a practical ponytail during races
physical.description: Alessia is of average height with a slender build and a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized checklists.
Insists on using a specific brand of Italian coffee beans in the team's coffee machine.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rapidly when under pressure.
